english.title: Registered person provide care and treatment to service user without consent
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[service provider]_
(B)_[registered manager]_

in respect of a regulated activity, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..), provided care and treatment to a service user, namely **(..SPECIFY SERVICE USER..), other than with the consent of

(C)_[that person]_
(D)_[a person lawfully acting on that person's behalf, the service user being under 16 and not competent to make a decision in relation to their care or treatment]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 11(1), 22(1)(a) and 23(4) of the Health and Social Care Act 2008 (Regulated Activities) Regulations 2014.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being the service provider or registered manager in respect of a registered activity
provided care and treatment to a service user
other than with the consent of that person or
a person lawfully acting on that person's behalf
if the service user is under 16 and not competent to make a decision in relation to their care or treatment

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 8(1) and (2) provides that a registered person must comply with regulations 9 to 20A in carrying on a regulated activity, unless the thing to be done has by another registered person in relation to the regulated activity concerned.
(ii) As per regulation 22(4), it is a defence for a registered person to prove that they took all reasonable steps and exercised all due diligence to prevent the breach.

Summary: FineTime limit for prosecutions:
6 monthsNote
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
